name: e_ens_t_cv_v1
status: FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_RESULT; the freeze record is the git commit that adds this file. Zero-training analysis of existing predictions.
purpose: Check whether the M0+GBT probability average (ENS, the only prior result that lowered false alarms without losing recall: feature_groupcv_v1, ens_groupcv_seed43_v1, ens_internal_test_v1) still helps on top of the current T0 baseline across 5 seeds at FP@R97, and whether averaging with GBT removes the GPS R97 loss that blocked T1 (fixed 100 epochs) in T and V.
not_a_repeat_of: feature_groupcv_v1 and ens_groupcv_seed43_v1 used the old M0 recipe (val-selected checkpoint, seeds 42/43, threshold 0.5). Here the MSTCA part is T0/T1 from t_selection_mstca_v1 (inner selection only, 5 seeds) and the operating point is FP@R97.

inputs.mstca: artifacts/t_selection_mstca_v1/cv/seed<s>_fold<f>/heldout_predictions.npz, epoch from selections.json (T0) or epoch 100 (T1); seeds 42-46, folds 0-2
inputs.gbt: artifacts/feature_groupcv_v1_20261105/gbt_heldout.npz (frozen GBT recipe, 130 window statistics, refit per outer fold on the 2 other folds, random_state 0; one GBT per fold, shared by all seeds)
inputs.fold_check: the GBT fold vector must equal the T outer fold of every window (both use sha256('h1cv|'+association_group) % 3); otherwise STOP
inputs.w0_gate: T0 FP@R97 for seeds 42/43/44 must equal 3595/3588/4610; otherwise STOP

evaluation: Pooled outer held-out over all 162069 train windows, per (arm, seed). Same as w_phase_balance_mstca_v1: FP@R97, ratio vs T0 per seed, geometric mean over 5 seeds, association_group cluster bootstrap 2000 replicates rng 20261106, one shared resample plan, t* recomputed per replicate.

criteria.C1: Aggregate FP ratio < 1, at least 4 of 5 per-seed ratios < 1, bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 1.
criteria.C2: At matched FP (arm threshold so its FP equals T0's FP@R97 per seed), seed-mean recall change of every fault class >= -1.0 pp vs T0 at its R97 threshold.
criteria.C3: At each arm's own R97 threshold, seed-mean recall drop of every fault class vs T0 <= 2.0 pp.
criteria.C4: Delta AP (arm - T0), seed mean, bootstrap 95% CI upper bound >= 0.
criteria.class_windows: ALL fault windows of the class, including late-hover faults (as in W). V-style (excluding late hover) reported descriptively.
criteria.verdict_per_arm: PASS if C1-C4 all hold, else FAIL with failed criteria. Undefined -> FAIL.
criteria.reading: Train CV only; val is burned and internal test/Real are locked, so a PASS makes the arm a provisional candidate, not an adoption. Both FAIL -> ENS does not carry over to T0/T1 at R97.

descriptive: GBT alone vs T0 (same criteria, not a decision)
E1 vs T1 (does GBT averaging fix T1's GPS drop)
Independent-normal FP by flight type and phase (pre/post the per-flight onset median), late-hover normal FP and late-hover GPS/Baro recall
Per-class recall at R97 excluding late-hover faults
forbidden: changing arms, combination rule (plain mean) or criteria after results
